invariants.rule: No operational domain mutation occurs before complete governed source validation and proposal acceptance.
Raw workbook content is never authoritative domain storage and is not used as a replacement database.
Only allowlisted fields can acquire source authority; unknown/discarded columns cannot influence identity, relationships, SLA, Inventory, Infrastructure or UI behavior.
Logical fingerprinting uses canonical allowlisted meaning; workbook packaging/order noise must not fabricate change.
Workbook omission has no lifecycle/deletion/unlink/cascade authority by default.
Source chronology, import chronology and business-event chronology are distinct and never silently substituted.
Exact replay is idempotent and produces no duplicate domain events or audit events.
Equal chronology with different logical content is conflict, never last-write-wins.
Fuzzy/descriptive similarity never establishes RFC/WFM/SR/reference identity.
WFM Task No. identity permits many distinct WFM tasks under one RFC; duplicate same-identity conflict is isolated to the affected safe scope.
High-risk classes cannot be configured into auto-accept.
The newest/highest-ranked malformed candidate fails visibly; automatic discovery does not silently fall back to older evidence.
Workbook processing is offline, bounded and non-executing; external references or active content cannot trigger network/code execution.
Import parsing/review performs no long-held SQLite write transaction; accepted mutations use short revalidated domain transactions.
Rejected/deferred/unresolved observations remain evidence and cannot fabricate entity disappearance.
